name: SPT-CL J0559-5249 (Hubble)
blurb: SPT-CL J0559-5249, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: sptclj05595249-hubble
story: A massive cluster of galaxies, found by the South Pole Telescope through the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect. Hubble imaged it to weigh the cluster by weak lensing, the slight distortion of background galaxies seen through it.

claims.text: SPT-CL J0559-5249 is one of the program's high-mass galaxy clusters
The clusters were detected by the South Pole Telescope via the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect
Hubble imaged it to measure its mass by weak lensing of background galaxies
